text:
Clara (Design): uploaded a new mini-tour variant in Figma -> https://www.figma.com/file/mini/onetour
Clara (Design): idea: replace long onboarding modal with a compact three-step mini-tour anchored to the workspace header. less modal fatigue.
Devon (PM): sounds promising. main KPI is reduce time-to-first-success. can we measure which step is most skipped?
Hana (Eng): we can emit events: tour_shown, tour_step_viewed, tour_step_completed, tour_skipped. minimal, anon by default.
Omar (DevEx): UX concern: anchored tour must not obscure important controls. propose it collapses to an icon on small viewports.
Clara (Design): agreed. mobile collapse and a small "?" toast. visual also uses motion for attention, but subtle to avoid motion sensitivity.
Pri (A11y): accessibility: avoid auto-focus when each step appears. use aria-live to announce step title and provide a "Start tour" focusable button.
Clara (Design): good call. we'll add a "Start tour" CTA. also microcopy options for step 2: connect repo vs. try sample. want low-commitment language.
Devon (PM): prefer "Try a sample" as the primary for early funnels. offer repo connect as optional next step.
Hana (Eng): implementation detail: sample launch should be one network call and a status toast. avoid blocking navigation.
Omar (DevEx): if a user dismisses the tour, remember for session. persist only if they opt into personalized tips.
Pri (A11y): checklist: 1) aria-live for step changes, 2) keyboard navigation (next/back/escape), 3) visible focus outlines, 4) motion-reduce respect.
Clara (Design): copy proposal for the banner: "Quick tour: get your first sample running in minutes." alt short: "Get a demo running fast." thoughts?
Devon (PM): keep shorter: "Get a demo running fast." we'll A/B test both. label the primary CTA "Start tour" and secondary "Browse samples".
onboard-bot: Preview deployed for feature/mini-tour-anchor -> https://preview.redwood.ai/mini-tour (staging)
Clara (Design): thanks all 60a I'll update figma with a11y changes and two copy variants. will post results after the A/B.
